integrity: Analytical proof with a separate high-precision finite checker; finite tests are not offered as a proof of the limit.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic concerns only the ordinary area Bergman kernel of circular annuli as the inner radius tends to one; general doubly connected domains and weighted kernels are not treated. The qualitative zero-fibre classification is known prior work. Earlier Sebbar--Falliero full text was inaccessible; independent validation not performed.
title: Exponential collapse of the zero-free radial band in thin-annulus Bergman kernels
